subject.title: Session reset on abort settle timeout causes complete context loss (session amnesia)

question: Should OpenClaw automatically bridge prior-session context after an embedded takeover reset, and what privacy boundary should govern transcript or trajectory replay?
rationale: Current main has reset archives and explicit reset memory capture, but the requested automatic replay after takeover changes what prior-session data may enter a new prompt and overlaps multiple open takeover/session-lock PRs.

options.title: Sequence active takeover PRs first
options.body: Review the open takeover/session-lock PRs as the near-term mitigation, then decide whether any context-bridge work remains.

options.title: Design a reset-context bridge
options.body: Specify a bounded, redacted, user-visible bridge from reset archives or trajectory into replacement sessions, with privacy and session-state tests.

options.title: Keep reset sessions isolated
options.body: Preserve the current isolation boundary and document manual recovery through trajectory export or memory rather than automatic replay.

recommendation.title: Sequence active takeover PRs first
recommendation.body: Review the open takeover/session-lock PRs as the near-term mitigation, then decide whether any context-bridge work remains.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the best available routing owner from current-line provenance and adjacent session-memory/takeover history, while the final decision spans product and security boundaries.
